shared_elements: human figures in profile facing one another
figures holding objects in raised hands
dense script/inscription integrated into the field
raised/carved relief figures with profile heads and frontal-tending shoulders
justification: Both depict profile human figures facing each other in an act of offering/presentation with raised hands holding objects, and both integrate dense writing into the decorated field, which is a moderately specific shared relationship. But A is a small figural vignette (worshippers flanking a rayed disc, children, tall headgear) sitting above many registers of pictographic text on a round-topped field, while B is a large-scale two-figure encounter with heavy beards, elaborate curled hair, a bowl and a fly-whisk-like implement, and text confined to a faint overlay; the proportions, bodily conventions and overall composition differ strongly.
